question: Which of the following states is characterised by salt marshes known as 'Rann'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Rann of Kutch** in Gujarat is one of the largest salt marshes in the world.
 
• It is located in the **Thar Desert** and spans approximately **7,500 square kilometers**.
 
• The area is famous for its seasonal salt marshes, which remain submerged during the monsoon and dry up to form salt flats during the dry season.
 
• The Rann of Kutch is divided into two parts: **Great Rann of Kutch** and **Little Rann of Kutch**.
 
• It is known for the **Rann Utsav**, a cultural festival showcasing Gujarat's heritage, held annually during winter.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Salt Marshes**:

 
 
• Salt marshes are coastal wetlands inundated by tides and dominated by salt-tolerant plants.
 
• They play a crucial role in maintaining ecological balance by serving as habitats for diverse flora and fauna.
 
 
 
• **Thar Desert**:
 
 
• The Thar Desert is the 17th largest desert in the world and spans parts of India and Pakistan.
 
• It is characterized by extreme temperatures, scant rainfall, and unique biodiversity.
 
 
 
• **Rann Utsav**:
 
 
• Rann Utsav is an annual cultural festival organized by the Gujarat government.
 
• It features folk music, dance performances, adventure sports, and handicrafts.
 
• The event attracts visitors globally and celebrates the rich heritage of Gujarat.
 
 
 
• **Unique Biodiversity**:
 
 
• The Rann of Kutch is home to the endangered Indian Wild Ass, found in the Little Rann of Kutch.
 
• The region also hosts migratory birds such as flamingos and pelicans during the winter season.
